_about: Graph view colour groups and search filter generated by Uni OS from _agent/uni-os.toml. Merge into .obsidian/graph.json with the framework's modules/obsidian/scripts/merge_obsidian_config.py (dry run first), or by hand in Graph view > Groups. Each query is an anchored regular expression built from the folder name, e.g. path:/^me\//. The order matters: the first matching group wins. The last entry only closes the list.
